1179: I've lived for cycling since I was young – my parents led me to it, or rather, bikes were never missing in our family and accompanied me throughout my childhood, whether it was a folding bike, a BMX, an MTB or a road bike. I got into cycle trial at 14, when I saw someone jumping on a bike over benches for the first time in my life. It was Michal Budský on a 20” bike. All at a time when I was racing MTB for Cykloprag Praha. Since then I've been hooked on cycle trial, and Michal Budský became my teacher.< I started on my old 26” Scott Vail MTB, which took a real beating during my first steps in trial. Suspension fork, chainrings, derailleur – basically everything went to pieces. In the end I bought an old, cracked 20” trial bike for about CZK 6,000, and since then I've gone through about 4 more bikes. In the following years, while studying at the Faculty of Civil Engineering in Brno, I switched to 26” bikes and gradually started riding cycle trial under the UCI, or rather the Czech Cycling Federation. In 2008 I founded my own online shop for trial components, which still operates today and which I keep trying to move forward. It also allows me to test new components, and I try to pass my experience on to customers so that everything suits them as well as possible. I don't sell….I help. In 2015 I joined the Czech national team, i.e. the national cycle trial squad, and took part in the European Championships in Italy and France. A great experience! In 2016 I managed to beat my trial teacher in the Czech Championship. There was no rivalry between us, but I was honestly glad that he had passed his experience on to me so well that I could use it even against him. I'll never forget that. Thank you! What next? It's time to pass my experience on in turn…..
